en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3991 - Al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: "

One dirham of usury is more severe in the sight of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, than thirty acts of fornication, all of which are committed with forbidden relatives, such as a maternal aunt or a paternal aunt."
